cohort: Pregnant women with lumbopelvic pain (n = 216) and without lumbopelvic pain (n = 207) were included after completing online surveys.
finding: Pregnant women experiencing lumbopelvic pain during pregnancy reported significantly higher levels of fear of childbirth compared to those without lumbopelvic pain, and fear of childbirth showed positive correlations with anxiety, depression, kinesiophobia, and catastrophizing.
